description:
MOBILE ORGAN PERFUSION & RETRIEVAL CENTRE BEFORE ZTCC MUMBAI
Rotarian Lal Goel, Founder and Charter President of the Rotary Club of Organ Donation International (RCODI) and Chairman of Organ Donation India Foundation and GYAN, was invited by the Zonal Transplant Coordination Centre, Mumbai (ZTCC-Mumbai), to present his vision for establishing a Mobile Organ Perfusion and Retrieval Centre.
The presentation was made during the meetings of the ZTCC Executive Committee (EC) and Governing Council (GC), held on 31st October 2026 at Bai Jerbai Wadia Hospital for Children, Mumbai.
The special invitation to participate as a guest speaker was extended by Dr S. K. Mathur, President, and Dr Bharat Shah, General Secretary, ZTCC Mumbai.
